decisions.reason: This lighting control unit sits squarely in the firm’s core airfield automation and integration knowledge base, so with growing industry demand and strong in-house engineering it is more likely to be refined and rolled out than withdrawn.

An air situation display for surveillance also matches the firm’s tower and operational-information capabilities, and its absorptive capacity in airport systems makes continued improvement and integration more likely than exit, though slightly less certain than for the core lighting product.
